_doc: Offline OSV/CVE snapshot for the skill-security install gate (security/osv-lookup.mjs). Small curated set of well-known npm advisories used to flag known-vulnerable dependencies in a foreign skill's package.json WITHOUT network access. This is the DEFAULT data source; --osv-online refreshes from OSV.dev and FAILS SOFT back to this snapshot on any error/timeout. Versions use simple semver ranges: introduced (inclusive) and fixed (exclusive). Hand-maintained; not exhaustive. Last curated 2026-06-13.

advisories.summary: event-stream malicious dependency (flatmap-stream) — supply-chain compromise that exfiltrated wallet credentials.
flatmap-stream is the malicious payload package from the event-stream incident. Any version is compromised.
lodash command injection via template / zipObjectDeep prototype pollution; fixed in 4.17.21.
lodash prototype pollution in zipObjectDeep; fixed in 4.17.20.
debug ReDoS via regular-expression denial of service; fixed in 2.6.9.
semver ReDoS in range parsing; fixed in 7.5.2.
ansi-regex ReDoS; fixed in 6.0.1 (and 5.0.1 on the 5.x line).
colors maintainer-sabotage (infinite-loop DoS) in 1.4.1+; a deliberate supply-chain self-corruption.
node-ipc protestware that wiped files based on geolocation — destructive supply-chain payload.
